DeviceIds: Device Ids to be ignored (comma seperated)
IP: IP/Domain of the Emby server (with port)
on save: When saving settings of the adapters will be restarted immediately.
PollIntervalDesc: Emby only pushes changes. The poll keeps the last activity up to date and is needed for the cleanup.
RemoveDeletedDevices: Remove objects of clients deleted in Emby (Dashboard > Devices)
RemoveInactiveDays: Remove objects of inactive clients after (days, 0 = off)
RemoveInactiveDaysDesc: Only clients the server no longer reports. Scripts and history settings on these objects are lost.
TimeoutDesc: Necessary when you watch more episodes in one row.
